description: Set how large one uploaded file may be in this company, in whole megabytes from 1 to the platform's (get_file_size_limit's 'platformMegabytes') — the company's administrators only. Omit 'megabytes' for the platform's own. Files already uploaded stay; every upload after is held to it, and a refusal names the number. The change is a line in the company's journal.

megabytes.description: Whole megabytes, 1 to the platform's; omit for the platform's own.

name: set_file_size_limit
title: Set file size limit
